name.description: Display name shown in the quest log and quest log lines.

description.description: The mission's framing, logged when it activates and shown on its quest card.

stages.description: Ordered stages. Omit entirely for a stageless mission (plain active → complete). Progress is one-way: stages advance forward only, and advancing past the last stage completes the mission.

id.description: Stage identifier, unique within the mission — referenced by questTrigger stage jumps and stage/stageReached conditions.

description.description: The objective, shown on the active quest card and logged when the stage becomes current.

advanceWhen.description: A condition tree (same shape as option/response conditions). Observed: re-evaluated on every state mutation and the moment the stage becomes current — a player already satisfying it advances instantly. Advancement is recorded, not continuously required; the condition turning false later never regresses the stage. Omit for stages advanced only by explicit questTrigger stage jumps.

rewards.description: Granted when this stage is completed (advanced past). Stages skipped by a forward jump grant nothing.

missionRewards.description: Granted on mission completion, after the final stage's own rewards.
